messages:
kevin: Quick question from intake  should we allow teams to onboard models that only ship quantized weights?
sana: What formats are we comfortable with? q4/q8 .bin or .pt?
kevin: Either, but registry needs metadata. Main concern is quality regressions compared to fp32.
lee: Proposal: accept quantized-only uploads but require a short parity harness: 50 seeded prompts, deterministic sampling, report an overlap score.
sana: Determinism is key. We should pin sampling config (greedy) + kernel versions for parity check.
ops-bot: Note: uploads >400MB will be validated async and owner notified.
kevin: Also add a required header describing quant recipe + tool version (e.g., bitsandbytes@0.40). That helps triage.
lee: If parity score below threshold, registry marks artifact as "internal" only and blocks Dedicated rollout. Owners can request manual review.
sana: Storage: keep baseline as an optional URL (registry must fetch during validation). For private installs, baseline must be packaged.
kevin: Action: I'll draft a short follow-up doc with metadata schema, parity spec, and trust levels. @lee can you propose an initial threshold (maybe 0.80 overlap)?
lee: Yep, will sketch it and prototype scorer next week.
sana: ack
